'''Political Liaison''' was a position within the hierarchy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Vandolay]] was a Political Liaison for COMPNOR while serving aboard the ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CCG-Vandolay">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Corporal Vandolay}}</ref>
